violation_type.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §744.3561(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside
violation_type.typical_finding: The emergency evacuation and relocation diagram did not have the shelter in place location listed on the diagram.

finding_variants.text: The emergency evacuation and relocation diagram did not have the shelter in place location listed on the diagram.
The operation emergency evacuation diagram did not include the designated location inside the child-care center where they will take shelter from threatening weather.

The operation's diagram did not include the designated location inside the operation where all caregivers and children take shelter from threatening weather.    This information was added to the diagram during the inspection.
At the time of inspection the operation's evacuation/relocation diagram did not indicate a shelter in place location. Caregivers could not identify a location in the building for sheltering in place.

The operation's emergency diagram did not include a designated location inside the operation where all caregivers and children take shelter from threatening weather.       The deficiency was corrected as this information was added to the diagram during the inspection.
